commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Making the world your friend is brightness, and staying constant in that friendship, not blooming at first and closing later, is understanding. The world here means the great. Be their friend unchanging, like a flower on a tree and not one on a pond, and you gain every joy. Some read it as not blooming in wealth and not closing in poverty.
